hypothesis: Use frozen expanded HCE in late endgames and the frozen phase H8 evaluator elsewhere to preserve the stronger endgame comparator while retaining neural gains.

data.authentication: Unchanged h4_data.authenticate v1 pins and full 53-file closure; inherited checkpoints bound to exact prior selection SHA and published v4 aggregate receipt. All roles are lineage checked, and independent JS/WASM comparator parity is required.
data.innerSplit: Existing unchanged sha256 chessy-h4-v2-inner-20260915 NUL positionFamily modulo5 ==0; source/family disjoint assertions. 6614 reused inner-validation rows. Frozen development checkpoint trained on only inner-training; final checkpoint is prior v4 full shared-train refit840.
data.caveat: Both inner and outer NNUE validation are repeatedly exposed development data. Expanded HCE was fitted on inner labels; development selection is exploratory, not fresh validation. No new labels. The sealed 2331-row NNUE test is not decoded by this screen.

inference.phase: p=min(24,N+B+2R+4Q), both colors. Existing phase bucket endgame is p<=6; opening p>=18.
inference.hard: expanded if p<=threshold; pure neural otherwise.
inference.smooth: w=clamp(p-lo,0,hi-lo), d=hi-lo; float=(w*neural+(d-w)*expanded)/d; integer=floor((2*(w*neural+(d-w)*expanded)+d)/(2*d)). Signed white-perspective ties toward positive infinity; neural evaluator retains own existing STM rounding before blend.
inference.overflow: All integer components abs<=10000; d<=24, so twice weighted numerator plus d has abs<=480024 and fits signed int32. Neural preexisting int32/int64 bounds remain checked by independent BigInt model decoder.
inference.sizeCaveat: Neural parameter bytes alone exclude HCE coefficients, evaluator code and packaged WASM. Actual runtime size and cost are separate gates; no production integration authorized by an offline loss result.

selection.eligibility: All six models must pass numerical parity/float/score guards or reject screen. Candidate needs same shipped-only inner phase guard (>=100 per phase and CE<=1.01 comparator); expanded HCE inner loss diagnostic only because fitted in-sample.
selection.objective: Minimum exact integer inner cross entropy among phase-eligible six; ties in listed order. No threshold extension, fitting, retraining or model seed/budget selection.
selection.freeze: Freeze chosen config and inherited final binary SHA in immutable decision before decoding nnue-validation; one outer candidate only, no reselection.
selection.outerGuards: Unchanged util.guard against both shipped and expanded HCE: >=0.5% relative aggregate CE improvement; MAE/RMSE<=1.02 baseline; p99 absolute cp error<=1.05 baseline; each coarse phase >=100 rows and CE<=1.01 baseline.
selection.stop: Any outer failure keeps test sealed. Success marks eligibility for separately invoked dataset-scoped one-shot test with unchanged v1 bootstrap guards. This executable contains no test decoder; root restores legacy state before any future opening.

ablations.where: All six gate variants plus shipped, expanded and pure neural on reused inner; sole selected hybrid on outer with baselines for its mandatory guards. No alternate gate scored on outer.
ablations.components: For selected gate on inner: hybrid, shipped-only, expanded-only, pure-neural, gated-neural with shipped fallback, expanded-base-plus-gated neural residual. Last component ablation changes residual baseline semantics and is diagnostic only, never eligible.
ablations.coverage: Publish counts for every material phase and potential <=3/4/5/6/7-piece coverage overall/endgame on allowed scored roles. Piece count is upper bound on Syzygy coverage; castling/material constraints not adjudicated.
ablations.gateTransition: For each inner row freeze both component cp and scan adjacent phase0..24. Report max/p95/p99 gate-only jump. Separately synthetic exhaustive signed rounding, endpoints, monotonicity, hard boundary and bound tests; no claim that synthetic jumps equal legal-move transitions.

numericalGuards.parity: All six hybrid predictions and pure-neural reference on every inner-validation row; one selected model on every outer row; independent JS BigInt blend and neural arithmetic, independent FEN phase.

execution.noReplace: Contract-scoped run-started and selection/validation state plus no-replace artifacts. Fatal error after admission consumes screen; no score-driven retries. Input hashes rechecked before every publication. Scope implementation must be committed/unchanged; unrelated research files may proceed concurrently.
execution.publication: Only code, exact preregistration, weight-free aggregate JSON/Markdown in Git; no raw source rows or weights. Checkpoints and state separately preserved.
execution.acceptance: This is offline development research. Formal family/estimator acceptance #175, runtime/device gate #84, equal-time search strength, licensing, production size and shipping review remain separate. Plateau of six gates is finite grid exhaustion, not universal saturation.

recovery.failure: Integral-valued float64 frozen expanded-HCE comparator was rejected by integer-only blend input validation before any gate metric, selection or outer decode. Shared-train labels were decoded. Original contract and run marker remain consumed and unmodified.
recovery.change: Verify comparator arrays are finite, exact integral, shape matches role rows and absolute cp<=10000; convert to int64. Keep same six gates, inherited models, selection and guards. New run is separately registered; no score-driven change.
